strata: layer x 20 equal-count quantile bins of magnitude gap, edges computed from all full blocks before evaluation
matching: exact per-layer/per-bin changed-block count and exact removed/added magnitude-rank pattern; sample blocks without replacement within layer/bin; include original guided blocks in eligible pool and report overlap
bin_ties: numpy quantile default linear; searchsorted internal edges side=right
rng: numpy Generator(PCG64), layer names sorted, bins sorted, guided rank patterns sorted, choose from remaining ascending block IDs; no validation-dependent generation

bn.mode: BN train, all other modules eval

stop: any provenance, reproduction, finite-value, matching or mask validity failure; no automatic retries
interpretation: random controls are conditional mask sensitivity of one fixed checkpoint, not independent training seeds; no test-set access
